english: As the Commanding Officer explained later,
text: As the Commanding Officer explained later 是给后面的说法标明出处，意思是“正如指挥官后来解释的”。这里 as 不是“因为”；引用某人说过的话可用 As someone said，说明来源而不是制造因果。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
